purpose: Prepare authorized observational validation and, only after separate approval, a reversible intervention comparison.

charters.title: RSCE service-line charges, retained work and capacity
charters.hypothesis: Some transaction work or charges may persist after shared-service handover; required client decisions and controls may explain apparent duplication.
charters.comparison_design: Same client/service-line, eligible transactions, period, demand, delegation and SLA; reconcile both sides of allocation, settlement, retained local work and provider external cost.
minimum_evidence: Mirror charge/recovery, settlement, reversal and timing records
Unique post and task records including client retained work
Service volume, queue, rework, payment/payroll continuity and SLA data
proposed_owner_roles: Client finance and service-line accountable managers
DOS HR and predecessor closeout custodians
charters.nonadditivity_rule: RSCE corporate total, mixed-client share and calendar SPM allocation are different perimeters; do not subtract them as overbilling.
activation_gaps: Accepted accountable owner and exact scope authorization
Usable comparable baseline and complete linked records
Prospective numerical thresholds, exposure/sample plan and observation window
Funded receiver capability and assigned fallback/rollback authority
charters.stop_and_fallback: Protect payroll, vendor-payment continuity and segregation of duties; fall back to approved current routing.
charters.restart_rule: No automatic restart; competent owner decision, resolved trigger and prospectively versioned plan required.
limitations: Research charter does not grant access or operational permission.
Reported historical implementation is distinct from this unstarted pilot.
Synthetic rehearsal is not a live operational trial.

charters.title: UNIFIL–UNSCOL asset receipt and procurement avoidance
charters.hypothesis: Transferred serviceable assets may meet a continuing requirement without an otherwise credible purchase; transfer, refurbishment and residual liabilities may offset the effect.
charters.comparison_design: Same asset/lot and requirement; match release, acceptance, inventory and procurement cancellation before computing net external acquisition/transfer cost.
minimum_evidence: Serial/VIN or lot, release and acceptance documents
Both inventories, condition, service life and custody records
Continuing approved requirement and credible procurement path
Canceled/changed procurement, sunk commitments, transport, refurbishment, disposal and residual liabilities
proposed_owner_roles: UNSCOL property, procurement and finance custodians
charters.nonadditivity_rule: Existing proposed vehicle, ICT and ration effects are prebooked; parent and components cannot be counted again as new effects.
activation_gaps: Accepted accountable owner and exact scope authorization
Usable comparable baseline and complete linked records
Prospective numerical thresholds, exposure/sample plan and observation window
Funded receiver capability and assigned fallback/rollback authority
charters.stop_and_fallback: Do not remove mission-critical source capability; protect custody, asset safety, environmental obligations and accepted receiver serviceability.
charters.restart_rule: No automatic restart; competent owner decision, resolved trigger and prospectively versioned plan required.
limitations: Research charter does not grant access or operational permission.
Reported historical implementation is distinct from this unstarted pilot.
Synthetic rehearsal is not a live operational trial.

charters.title: BINUH–UNSOH aviation and support full-system cost
charters.hypothesis: Shared support may reduce external delivery cost while preserving readiness; intermission payments and reported handover alone cannot establish the effect.
charters.comparison_design: Same service and flight requirement, period, threat/demand exposure and readiness; eliminate internal reimbursements and include provider vendor cost, retained posts and residual obligations.
minimum_evidence: Signed scope/SLA, effective dates and service performance terms
Paired AP/AR, invoice, settlement, reversal and service-period records
Flight IDs/hours, vendor bills, allocation keys and readiness
Retained/transferred posts, payroll, overtime, separation cost and emergency capability
proposed_owner_roles: BINUH and UNSOH mission support accountable managers
Both finance controllers and RSCE settlement custodians
UNSOH aviation, procurement and HR custodians
charters.nonadditivity_rule: Aviation proposal reduction is embedded; broader all-support reimbursement is an internal payment with different scope and is not netted mechanically.
activation_gaps: Accepted accountable owner and exact scope authorization
Usable comparable baseline and complete linked records
Prospective numerical thresholds, exposure/sample plan and observation window
Funded receiver capability and assigned fallback/rollback authority
charters.stop_and_fallback: Preserve flight safety, emergency evacuation, security access and mission prioritization through an authorized fallback.
charters.restart_rule: No automatic restart; competent owner decision, resolved trigger and prospectively versioned plan required.
limitations: Research charter does not grant access or operational permission.
Reported historical implementation is distinct from this unstarted pilot.
Synthetic rehearsal is not a live operational trial.
